entries.title: Sea of Stars
entries.definitive_edition: Sea of Stars Sunset Edition on Windows PC with Throes of the Watchmaker

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Sunset Edition and Throes of the Watchmaker installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with final update and DLC content.

primary.version: Sunset Edition plus Throes of the Watchmaker
primary.why: The Windows PC Sunset Edition route is the best archival version because it includes the base game, Dawn of Equinox-era co-op/default update state, the free Throes of the Watchmaker expansion, and the June 2026 final Sunset Edition update while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility. Console and mobile routes add access options, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Sea of Stars on Steam or GOG for Windows PC, update to Sunset Edition, finish the main game, then play the free Throes of the Watchmaker expansion.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Throes of the Watchmaker and Sunset Edition final update.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sunset Edition is the final free update, not a separate paid remaster. Use the updated build rather than an old launch build.
